## 主张 Claim

任意两个有局部左右单位的接合结构中，所有片段在无引用关联语言中同测。该粗说明对这套问题精确且最小，却可把同一已消耗历史的不可自接合误成可自接合。 / All fragments in any two joining structures with local left/right units agree in the unanchored incidence language. The coarse account is exact and reduced for that language yet can turn the same spent history’s impossible self-join into a possible one.

Canonical source: [ExplanatoryJoiningAnchors.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/deeper/ExplanatoryJoiningAnchors.lean)

- HasUnits 对一般退化定理；具体反例复用 budgetProcess 的 admitted histories、trace_has_units 和 spend_cannot_self_join。 / HasUnits for the general collapse; the concrete case reuses budgetProcess admitted histories, trace_has_units and spend_cannot_self_join.

反例在已有单次消耗过程中比较真实片段与其粗代码；遗漏的是固定输入关系，不是任意本体身份或自由切换的谓词。 / The example compares an actual fragment of the existing one-use process with its coarse code; the omission is fixed-input joining, not arbitrary ontological identity or a freely toggled predicate.

## 检验与边界 Validation and boundaries

Lean 4.29.1 实查：本次43项新声明，213项继承审计，共256项；新9空依赖、34标准，7项含经典选择。冻结源码、日志与回执逐字绑定；非独立 agent 验收。 / Lean 4.29.1 checks 43 new declarations and 213 inherited audits, 256 total; new 9 empty and 34 standard dependency lists, 7 with classical choice. Frozen source/logs bind to the receipt; no independent-agent acceptance.

否定的是无引用语言足以解释完整接合的候选推论；不是生成基础不可能。局部单位不由本轮证明为普遍条件；退化定理不需有限性。 / Refutes the candidate inference that unanchored questions suffice for full joining, not the possibility of generative grounding. Local units are not proved universal; the collapse theorem needs no finiteness.
